title: How Reliable Are Large Language Models for Soil Organic Carbon Assessment? An Australian Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2610.18201v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Soil organic carbon (SOC) is an indicator of agricultural soil condition and carbon storage, but numerical outputs from large language models (LLMs) require validation before use in monitoring or management. We evaluated seven general-purpose LLM configurations on three direct-response tasks: estimating 0--10 cm SOC concentrations for 308 Australian paddocks under two information conditions, calculating SOC stock in 120 matched scenarios, and comparing 300 paddock pairs. References were measured SOC records or deterministic calculations; response validity, repeated-call dispersion and estimated API cost were assessed separately. Additional measured soil attributes reduced concentration mean absolute error by 13--62\% across configurations, although high-SOC underprediction and paddock-specific errors persisted. translated_title: 大语言模型在土壤有机碳评估中的可靠性如何？——一项澳大利亚基准测试
translated_abstract: 土壤有机碳（SOC）是农业土壤状况和碳储存的指标，但大语言模型（LLM）产生的数值输出在用于监测或管理之前需要经过验证。我们在三项直接响应任务上评估了七种通用大语言模型配置：在两种信息条件下估计308个澳大利亚牧场的0–10厘米SOC浓度、计算120个匹配场景中的SOC储量，以及比较300对牧场。参考值为实测SOC记录或确定性计算结果；响应有效性、重复调用的离散度以及估计的API成本被分别评估。引入额外的实测土壤属性使各配置的浓度平均绝对误差降低了13–62%，但高SOC低估和牧场特定误差依然存在。在使用方程原生单位且不含粗碎屑的情况下，六种配置在储量计算中表现出很高的准确性，但准确…
tldr: 该论文以澳大利亚308个牧场的实测数据为基准，评估了七种通用大语言模型在土壤有机碳浓度估计、储量计算和牧场对比三项任务上的可靠性，发现补充实测土壤属性可将误差降低13–62%，但高有机碳低估和牧场特定误差仍然存在。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks seven general-purpose LLMs on three soil organic carbon assessment tasks using measured data from 308 Australian paddocks, showing that additional measured soil attributes reduce mean absolute error by 13–62%, though high-SOC underprediction and paddock-specific errors persist.
